## **DESCRIPTION**

* Nunu & Willump achieved the funni, and now they play goofy ahh sounds when using their abilities, ranging from "GAS GAS GAS" when using W, to a russian kid screaming "BLYAAAAT" when ulting. Everything Nunu related has been changed in order to make the most ridiculous and painful gameplay experience.
